Anya (CS): Hey team — kicking off onboarding for Zenith Health. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a ramp timeline. Quick Qs: who owns SSO, who's the primary technical contact, any compliance/data residency blockers? I propose a 6-week timeline with a pilot demo in week 3. Draft docs: https://confluence.redwood/zenith-onboard (draft).

Jordan (SE): I can own SSO + auth integration. Primary tech contact is Devin from Zenith (cc'd below). Compliance: they mentioned SOC2 + HIPAA scoping; also flagged EU-only data residency in initial email. Pilot in week 3 sounds right.

Matthew (Eng): From eng side: expect ~2 weeks for SDK integration, 1 week for validation, then pilot demo. Recommend starting with hosted API for the pilot, then move to Dedicated if latency/cost needs dictate. Note: Zenith will use long-context chat — suggest 8k context model or quantized 16k variant. Blockers: CORS and IP allowlist for their infra.

Sophia (ML): For ML success criteria we need a prompt baseline. Request: 30 sample prompts (mix of chat + long docs). Proposed success metrics: "response accuracy >= 85%" (based on eval rubric) and "median latency < 350ms" for chat. We'll run a small eval in week 1 and again pre-pilot. Also want to capture hallucination logs and top-5 failure cases.

Anya (CS): Actions I’ll track:
1) @Jordan confirm SSO timeline by EOD today.
2) @Matthew share SDK snippet + test account and a short runbook.
3) @Devin please send sample prompts and security contact.
4) I'll schedule weekly 30-min syncs (Mon 10:00am PT) — first one next Monday.

Mini checklist (copyable):
```
- Week 0: Account + billing setup, test API keys issued
- Week 1: SDK integration + sample prompts collected, baseline eval
- Week 2: End-to-end flow + security review (IP allowlist, CORS)
- Week 3: Pilot demo with stakeholders, collect feedback
- Week 4-5: Iterate on prompts, tune batching/quantization
- Week 6: Production rollout + handoff doc
```

Anya (CS): Also: please flag any renewal risks early (e.g., strict residency + compliance = potential Private deployment). :calendar:

Devin (Zenith): Hi all — Devin here. Pilot week 3 is fine. I'll send sample prompts and the security contact (secops@zenith.com) by EOD tomorrow. Confirming EU-only data residency — will need Dedicated/Private for that.

Matthew (Eng): Noted EU-only requirement. That pushes infra planning — we'll need to coordinate with eng-infra for region capacity and any export controls. @lina_infra can you advise if we have spare EU capacity for a Dedicated instance in a 6-week window?

lina_infra: We have limited spare capacity in eu-west1 for Q2 but can prioritize if procurement and billing are confirmed this week. Need an exact instance size (GPU count) and expected QPS.

Jordan (SE): I'll sync with Devin on SSO specifics (SAML vs OIDC) and send a short checklist for auth flows.

Sophia (ML): One more ask — Devin, can you include 5-10 edge-case prompts where hallucination is most costly (PHI-related)? We'll run those as high-priority tests.

Devin (Zenith): Yup, sending those edge cases with the prompt set. Security contact and compliance doc coming in one email.

calendar-bot: Recurring meeting scheduled: Zenith Onboarding Weekly | Mondays 10:00am PT — starts next week — invites sent to participants.

Jordan (SE): +1 on timeline. I'll put the SSO checklist in the shared doc.

Anya (CS): Great — I'll convert this thread into the onboarding playbook and share the Confluence link after today's notes. Thanks, everyone — will update tasks in the playbook and assign owners.
